parsed.why: Low-risk local assessment and no state bathroom ban, but a national-legislature facilities restriction applies directly and can be overridden; arrests show enforcement. Protective climate is real but fragile.

Most-protective tier: public-accommodations gender-identity protections, hate-crime penalties, panic-defence repeal, gender-neutral single-occupant bathrooms, shield laws. No local bathroom ban; national border/document exposure remains.

Broad gender-identity protections in public accommodations, hate crime, panic-defence repeal, accessible ID markers; but youth-targeting school/sports policies and mixed official posture. Adult visitor exposure low; national border exposure remains.

State bathroom/locker ban in schools and government buildings, complaint form, and a documentary defense visitors cannot meet; no public-accommodations protection. Hate-crime and marker-change laws partially offset. Hostile legislature.

Bathroom ban expanded to public colleges/universities; no hate-crime statute; prison treatment freeze; unrepealed sodomy and hostile record. Weaker recourse than dossier 4; national border exposure adds.
